title: Adjunction and resolution normalization of ambient direct-image and open compositors
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes; their structure maps are not required to be separated [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For each $T$, choose either $\mathscr M_T=\operatorname{Mod}((A_n)_T)$ at one fixed $n$, or the category $\mathscr M_T$ of module sheaves $M_n$ over $(A_n)_T$ with semilinear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{A_{n+1}\to A_n}M_n$ and compatible componentwise morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(\mathscr M_T)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a scheme map $f$ write $f^*$ for exact constant-coefficient module inverse image and $P_f=D(f^*)$; for an open immersion $j$ write $j_!$ for exact extension by zero and $J_j=D(j_!)$. Use the specified adjunctions $P_f\dashv S_f=Rf_*$ and $J_j\dashv P_j$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. System operations are constructed simultaneously on the ringed diagram site, before finite evaluation, scalar restriction or total limit [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections].

Use the canonical inverse-image compositor $d_{v,u}:P_uP_v\cong P_{vu}$ induced by the constant-ring local tensor formula $(m\otimes a)\otimes b\mapsto m\otimes c_u(a)b$, with its composite-unit normalization [lem-sf-proetale-tensor-composition-unit, lem-pur-proetale-constant-ring-composition]. Let $c_{v,u}:S_vS_u\cong S_{vu}$ be the inverse of its adjunction conjugate. For composable open immersions $j:A\hookrightarrow B$ and $b:B\hookrightarrow T$, let $e_{b,j}:J_bJ_j\cong J_{bj}$ be the inverse open-adjunction conjugate of $P_jP_b\cong P_{bj}$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate, def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction].

These $c,e$ are the canonical unbounded derived direct-image and open-extension compositors. Each identifies both unit and counit for the composite adjunction with the unit and counit of the single-map adjunction. In particular, $c$ agrees on K-injective resolutions with the ordinary direct-image composition comparison, and $e$ agrees with localization of the ordinary open-extension comparison; these identifications also hold on the ringed diagram category itself. Here a complex is K-injective when every chain map from an acyclic complex to it is null-homotopic.

They are natural, associative and unital. Explicitly, for $u:X\to Y$, $v:Y\to Z$, $w:Z\to T$,
$$c_{w,vu}\circ(S_wc_{v,u})=c_{wv,u}\circ(c_{w,v}S_u),$$
and for opens $j,b,a$,
$$e_{a,bj}\circ(J_ae_{b,j})=e_{ab,j}\circ(e_{a,b}J_j).$$
The identity equations use the adjunction-normalized identity comparisons. These equations identify the two composites even when the underlying functors are only canonically isomorphic. Under the displayed comparisons the threefold adjunction Hom bijection is the three successive specified Hom bijections, independent of parenthesization.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q134-7986e5a35 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all 23 cited statements, the parent and the sibling lem-sf-ambient-pullback-tensor-coherence. Sources checked: Stacks 0D6E (sites-cohomology l.4011, composition by uniqueness of adjoints) and the tags table for 09T5, 08BJ, 070I, 015F, 03D3, 070Y and 070K; the blueprint main-20261015 fix-prop-projection-formula.proof.md l.12 sentence. There is no SGA citation. The types of c and e (inverse conjugates) check out. Step 6's unit and counit formulas re-derive correctly, and Step 7's mate-pasting coherence is correct. Three faults were repairable, and I fixed all three in the item file. (1) E5/C1, Step 5: the item never connects P_j, which is restriction to the localized site in the open adjunction, with the scheme-pullback compositor d. The fix cites lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization and lem-exc-proetale-open-derived-image. It then shows d^0_{b,j} is the relocalization identity: the unit equation of lem-sf-proetale-tensor-composition-unit holds because q preserves the projections, and lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation gives uniqueness. (2) C4, Step 3: the specified adjunction of def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations is the bijection of lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general. With s=id and t=id its formula is the termwise transpose. The fix cites that node and adds a uniqueness argument for the system adjunction, because the resolving-normalization node only asserts that some adjunction exists. (3) Steps 1 and 4: K-injective resolutions and the ringed-topos composition comparison are applied to systems without the small-site realization. The fix cites lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization. The four added generic tools are declared in tool_uses, and none of them creates a cycle.
